editorial.blurb: El Taco Toro serves authentic Mexican cuisine with halal options, where exceptional meat quality and genuine care shine through in every dish.
editorial.insiderTip: Order anything with steak—tacos or quesadillas—rather than chicken; reviewers consistently rave about the steak's quality.

topDishes.note: delicious and melts in your mouth
very tasty, highly praised by regulars
